products.modalDescription: The Sony A6400 is a versatile APS-C mirrorless camera that delivers exceptional image quality and lightning-fast autofocus performance. With its 24.2MP APS-C sensor, real-time tracking, and advanced video capabilities, the A6400 is perfect for content creators, vloggers, and enthusiast photographers who demand professional results in a compact, portable body.
modalFeatures: 24.2MP APS-C Exmor CMOS sensor for stunning image quality
Real-time Eye AF for humans and animals with 425-point phase-detection system
Up to 11 fps continuous shooting with AF/AE tracking
4K video recording with full pixel readout and no pixel binning
180-degree tiltable LCD touchscreen for easy vlogging and selfies
Built-in Wi-Fi and NFC for instant sharing and remote control
ISO range of 100-32000, expandable to 102400 for low-light shooting
High-speed USB Type-C connectivity for fast data transfer

products.modalDescription: The Canon RF 50mm f/1.8 STM is a compact and lightweight standard lens for Canon's full-frame mirrorless RF mount cameras. With its fast f/1.8 maximum aperture and STM stepping motor, it delivers beautiful bokeh and near-silent autofocus for both photos and videos. Perfect for portraits, street photography, and everyday shooting.
modalFeatures: Compact and lightweight design at just 160g
Fast f/1.8 maximum aperture for low-light and shallow depth of field
STM stepping motor for smooth and quiet autofocus during video recording
0.3m minimum focusing distance for versatile close-up shooting
Full-frame coverage for Canon RF mount cameras
7-blade circular aperture for beautiful bokeh
High-quality optics with minimal chromatic aberration
Affordable entry into Canon's RF lens system

products.modalDescription: The Sony RX100 VII is an incredible pocket-sized compact camera that packs pro-level performance. Featuring a versatile 24-200mm zoom lens, lightning-fast autofocus borrowed from the Alpha 9, and a microphone input, it is the ultimate tool for vloggers and travel photographers who need power without the bulk.
modalFeatures: High-magnification ZEISS® Vario-Sonnar T* 24-200mm zoom lens
Real-time Tracking and Real-time Eye AF for humans and animals
20fps blackout-free shooting with AF/AE tracking
4K HDR (HLG) recording with external microphone jack
Single Burst Shooting at up to 90fps for capturing fleeting moments
Retractable OLED viewfinder and 180-degree tiltable screen
Advanced image stabilization for smooth 4K video (Active mode)
Super slow motion recording at up to 960fps

products.modalDescription: The Sony ZV-E10 is the perfect interchangeable-lens mirrorless camera for vloggers and content creators. It combines a large APS-C sensor with specialized vlogging features like the Product Showcase setting, a vari-angle screen, and a high-quality directional 3-capsule microphone.
modalFeatures: Large APS-C sensor for professional-looking background bokeh
Vari-angle LCD screen ideal for selfie-shooting and vlogging
Product Showcase Setting for quick focus transitions to objects
Background Defocus button to instantly switch bokeh on/off
Directional 3-capsule microphone with included wind screen
Real-time Eye AF and Tracking for keeping focus on you
4K video recording with oversampling from 6K
Live streaming capability via USB connection

products.modalDescription: The Sony FX30 is an entry into Sony's acclaimed Cinema Line, bringing professional cinematic standards to a compact form factor. Designed for filmmakers, it features a Super 35 sensor with Dual Base ISO, S-Cinetone colors, and a built-in cooling fan for unlimited 4K recording.
modalFeatures: Super 35mm format for cinematic depth of field
Dual Base ISO (800 / 2500) for clean low-light imagery
S-Cinetone profile for cinematic color right out of camera
High-performance 4K 120p recording (with 1.6x crop)
Dependable Fast Hybrid AF with Real-time Eye AF
Flexible Log shooting (Cine EI, Cine EI Quick, Flexible ISO)
User-imported LUT support for monitoring and recording
Active Mode image stabilization and breathing compensation

products.modalDescription: The Sony A7 III is the ultimate all-rounder, defining the standard for full-frame mirrorless cameras. Balancing resolution, speed, and video capabilities, it features a back-illuminated full-frame sensor and a high-capacity battery, making it the go-to choice for wedding photographers and hybrid shooters.
modalFeatures: Back-illuminated Full-Frame sensor for outstanding low-light performance
High-capacity NP-FZ100 battery (approx. 710 shots per charge)
5-axis in-body image stabilization (5.0-step compensation)
4K HDR movie recording with full pixel readout (no binning)
Standard ISO range up to 51200, expandable to 204800
Dual SD Card Slots (one UHS-II compatible) for backup
Fast Hybrid AF with 693 phase-detection points covering 93% of frame
Real-time Eye AF specifically tuned for portraits

products.modalDescription: The Canon EOS 2000D is the ideal entry-level DSLR for beginners stepping up from smartphone photography. It offers an intuitive way to capture professional-looking photos with background blur. With its optical viewfinder and helpful built-in guides, it's the perfect tool for learning the basics of photography.
modalFeatures: 24.1MP APS-C sensor for detailed images and bokeh
Optical viewfinder for an authentic DSLR shooting experience
Built-in Wi-Fi and NFC for easy transfer to Canon Camera Connect
Creative Auto mode and Feature Guide for beginners
Full HD 1080p video recording for cinematic moments
Compatible with the extensive range of Canon EF and EF-S lenses
Scene Intelligent Auto allowing simple point-and-shoot
Built-in flash and hot-shoe for external accessories

products.modalDescription: The Canon EOS R6 Mark II is a powerhouse hybrid camera that masters both photography and videography. It features a newly developed 24.2MP sensor, blazing fast 40fps continuous shooting, and advanced subject detection AF, making it one of the most versatile cameras on the market.
modalFeatures: Next-generation Dual Pixel CMOS AF II with deep learning subject tracking
Blazing fast 40fps electronic shutter for sports and wildlife
High-quality 4K 60p video oversampled from 6K width (no crop)
In-Body Image Stabilization providing up to 8 stops of compensation
Focus breathing correction for professional video transitions
Pre-shooting mode (captures 0.5s before you press the shutter)
UVC/UAC support for plug-and-play webcam use
Dual UHS-II SD card slots for backup and overflow
